name: Queue sweep
description: PDF documents through one queue. Each job changes exactly one option from the job before it, so a wrong page names its own option. The pages.pdf jobs are the ones that prove the raster path: on an IPP printer that does not read PDF they are rendered here and sent as PWG Raster, and every fault that path can have is visible on the sheet.

jobs.description: four pages in colour, to check the raster geometry
the same four pages in grayscale, which is one octet a pixel instead of three
pages 2 and 4 only, selected by the converter and not by the printer
four pages duplex on the long edge, to check the back-side transform
